pue.boundary: Supplier silicon/networking/system content; not an operated compute-energy perimeter
pue.basis: PUE = matched facility energy / IT equipment energy. Supplier content needs no PUE; site deployment PUE is not_disclosed. Remove prior numeric 1 placeholder; do not substitute generation/IT capacity ratios.

model.revenue_period: Quarter ended 2026-07-26 for recognized revenue; 2026-08-26 generation opportunity guidance separately
model.revenue_scope: Supplier system content; recognized Data Center sales are contextual, not an operator numerator. Future conditional revenue share requires a separate cohort model.
model.capacity_time_basis: No active period-average denominator is reconstructed because supplier delivery revenue is not recurring cloud revenue. PORTS4250 IT MW is prospective full build and is used only for contingent-credit density.

formulas.deployment_pue: sum(facility_energy)/sum(IT_energy); IT-energy-weighted, not average site ratios
formulas.conditional_sensitivity: For fixed facility capacity and annual revenue: rate = R*PUE/(facility_MW*u). For verified IT capacity: rate=R/(IT_MW*u); PUE does not change IT denominator.
formulas.jevons: If matched realized price declines d, exact break-even volume growth=d/(1-d); cost/performance benchmarks are not realized d.

assumptions.basis: Generation delivery stock/flow differs from annual recurring cloud service revenue.

assumptions.value: 60% growth only for same supplier-component capital/gross-revenue ratio
assumptions.basis: Whole-project capex also includes non-NVIDIA hardware/facility costs; replacement life, opex and financing unknown.

PORTS support is $24.71M maximum contingent exposure per planned IT MW, not capex or annual monetization. Delayed energization and multiple GPU refreshes matter over a20-year lease.
